doc: docs/FACTORY.md §2. Repos resolve to <workspace>/<name>; workspace = FACTORY_WORKSPACE or the parent of this checkout. `{python}` in a command is the running interpreter. Rows marked virtual are DAG repos with no checkout (operator surfaces).

dottie.deploy: vercel:arxiviq (apps/arxiviq; Root Directory must be apps/arxiviq)
dottie.notes: `make ci` is the full local mirror of ci.yml; these three are the fast subset.

vector-hub.notes: Hub of the five games; vector-core is the shared library the games import.

vector-hoops.notes: No tests, no lint, no CI (DAG vector-ci-green adds them). pipeline/ holds only train_with_text_fusion.py; the handoff's train_mtnn.py/eval.py are not in this repo.

vector-gridiron.notes: cml.yaml also present; dottie deleted its own copy because it never ran green.

vector-unified.notes: data/* is gitignored: the joint matrix and caches exist only on the box (see factory/datasets.json).

vector-equities.notes: Trainer and eval need PYTHONPATH=../vector-hub/packages/vector-core/src (see train_queue.json env).

vector-arcade.deploy: vercel: arcade.dumbmodel.com (currently served from an archived bluehen project)

vector-schools.notes: No tests registered; not on the DAG.

vector-fusion-demo.notes: Static single page; nothing to validate beyond a deploy.

jcamd.notes: Static site; vercel.json is the only thing that can break a deploy.

alamost-com.notes: Next.js 14; photo listing needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY at runtime (paid, optional).

arxiviq.deploy: vercel: arxiviq.com (today served from bluehen's arxiv-exam-app project; DAG repoint-arxiviq)
arxiviq.notes: Data scripts live here; the Next.js site is moving to dottie/apps/arxiviq.

who-e.deploy: vercel: who-e.com (project linked to the yubipet repo)

ava-agi-factory-v6-4.notes: Parked in the DAG (ava-factory); GPU training track.

bluehen.notes: Archived 2026-09-05 (PR #6); nine Vercel projects still serve live domains (DAG bluehen-vercel-cleanup).

agent-lasso.notes: Archived 2026-09-05; slasso dashboards stay on Vercel.

vercel.notes: Operator clicks in the Vercel dashboard (team cams-projects-c5c4c5f6).

vector-*.notes: A DAG node spanning the five game repos; work lands in each repo's own row.
